title: APM continuation: privacy-safe still-image derivatives
coordinate_convention: All rectangles are [x,y,width,height] in pixels, origin at the top left; extents are half-open. Source coordinates refer to the original dimensions; output coordinates refer to the cropped derivative.
provenance_caveat: Source filesystem modification times are retained as capture-file provenance. They can change during copying or export and are not independently verified capture times, ingestion times, or trace-event times. UI times may use another timezone (UTC-07:00 is visible in relevant captures).
privacy_treatment: Crops omit global navigation/profile identity and unnecessary surrounding UI. Opaque black masks cover unique trace identity in image 54 and process/runtime/span values in image 56. The generic demonstration service name and environment/version query remain visible. The commit tag pixels in screenshot-only image 57 were explicitly authorized for retention and are isolated from repository/account identity. No source code or secrets were read.
evidence_limits: Images 49–55 establish a listed APM service, staging selection, an empty visible 15-minute query, a one-hour historical result with 47 indexed spans, a historical HTTP span overview, and an empty recent SDK configuration view. Images 56–57 are separate screenshot-only captures made after the Raw09 motion recording ended; they show ingested historical span tags for version, environment, and commit. None establishes successful Live Debugger enablement, a started session, current instrumentation, or source retrieval. The Widen Time Frame interaction and Agent-last-seen eligibility statement are not shown in these stills.
